scripts.setup: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm && npm install
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.venv/bin/python')){console.error('\n[dev] Setup not run yet — first run:  npm run setup\n');process.exit(1)}" && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
